definitions.gloss: engaging in, working at, being involved in
definitions.explanation: To be engaged in a particular kind of work, occupation, or activity. A formal word used primarily in written and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {農業|のうぎょう}に{従事|じゅうじ}している。
{長年|ながねん}{研究|けんきゅう}に{従事|じゅうじ}してきた。
examples.english: I have been engaged in research for many years.

examples.japanese: この{工場|こうじょう}では{約|やく}{三百|さんびゃく}{人|にん}が{製造|せいぞう}{業務|ぎょうむ}に{従事|じゅうじ}している。
examples.english: About three hundred people are engaged in manufacturing work at this factory.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word most commonly seen in resumes, official documents, surveys, and news articles. In everyday conversation, {働|はたら}く or {仕事|しごと}をする is more natural. Almost always used with the particle に: Xに{従事|じゅうじ}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農業|のうぎょう}に{従事|じゅうじ}する: to be engaged in agriculture
- {研究|けんきゅう}に{従事|じゅうじ}する: to be engaged in research
- {業務|ぎょうむ}に{従事|じゅうじ}する: to be engaged in duties
- {従事|じゅうじ}{者|しゃ}: worker, person engaged in
